profile.heroBio: Computer & Data Science undergraduate at Alexandria University focused on AI Engineering, Machine Learning, and LLM-based systems. Experienced in building secure MCP servers, persistent multi-agent workflows, and bilingual RAG pipelines using Python, LangGraph, and FastAPI. Seeking AI/ML Engineering Internships.
profile.aboutHtml:
I'm Abdelrahman Eslam, a Computer & Data Science undergraduate at Alexandria University (Class of 2028) focused on AI Engineering, Machine Learning, and LLM-based systems.

I build production-oriented AI applications: secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, stateful multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, and bilingual hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines combining dense vector search, BM25 keyword matching, and cross-encoder rerankers.

Active as an AI & Data Science research team member in Argus Team and organizing student academic resources in Material Team at Alexandria University. Actively seeking AI/ML Engineering Internships.

projects.title: Terms – AI-Powered Legal Document Analysis
projects.description: AI-powered legal document analysis platform combining NLP, Transformer models, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation to analyze complex legal documents. Built hybrid retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, clause classification, and bilingual Arabic/English document grounding.

projects.title: Greenfield Autonomous Multi-Agent Platform
projects.description: Persistent multi-agent platform coordinating specialized agents for agricultural operations through dynamic handoffs and shared orchestration. Built stateful LangGraph workflows with durable SQLite checkpoints, Self-RAG domain knowledge grounding, and Docker containerization.

projects.title: WanderPath Travel Agency – Secure MCP Server
projects.description: Secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI agents to interact with enterprise travel data through controlled tools rather than direct database access. Implemented role-based authorization, JSON Schema validation, and Human-in-the-Loop confirmation.

projects.title: Excel MCP Server
projects.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to inspect, query, edit, and format Excel workbooks asynchronously with zero latency.

projects.title: FIFA Player Market Value ML Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end Machine Learning pipeline achieving 96% R² score predicting football player valuations with automated domain feature engineering, cross-validation, and hyperparameter tuning.

projects.title: Linear Regression Analysis From Scratch
projects.description: NumPy implementation of Linear Regression built from mathematical foundations, benchmarking vectorized Gradient Descent vs. Closed-Form Normal Equation with L1/L2 regularization.

projects.title: End-to-End Data Science Methodology

projects.title: FCDS Data Mining & Pattern Discovery
